mapper.select: SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick, fu.portrait as from_user_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user fu ON d.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON d.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE d.doumail_id = #{doumailId} LIMIT 1

SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick, fu.portrait as from_user_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user fu ON d.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON d.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId1} AND d.to_user_id = #{userId2} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.from_user_id = #{userId2} AND d.to_user_id = #{userId1} AND d.status != 2) ORDER BY d.chat_time ASC

SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick, fu.portrait as from_user_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user fu ON d.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON d.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE (d.from_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 1) OR (d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.status != 2) GROUP BY LEAST(d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id), GREATEST(d.from_user_id, d.to_user_id) ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC

SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick, fu.portrait as from_user_portrait FROM doumail d LEFT JOIN user fu ON d.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON d.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE d.to_user_id = #{userId} AND d.read = 0 AND d.status != 2 ORDER BY d.chat_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO doumail (from_user_id, to_user_id, chat_msg, status, read) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{chatMsg}, #{status}, #{read})
